population: SHA-first 128 legal M2A train queries outside M0C, M1, OBS-A1 and FRAG-B0; R1 action outcomes may have been observed but M2 actions have not
action_rule: M2A legal actions sorted by smallest absolute cumulative token change, then delayed sentence index; first three distinct contexts; first action is fixed rule
gate: GO to query-grouped learnability design only if at least 12 no-anchor-break Complete repairs across at least two distinct baseline failure masks in the 128 fresh paired queries; do not train from this gate alone
